text: I'm really sorry to message, I'm a childminder and I've got a 1 month old baby boy with me tonight. He's got a temperature of 39.8 and he won't settle to sleep, though otherwise he seems himself. But I've just noticed little dark red pinprick dots on his tummy and I pressed a glass on them like I was taught and they didn't go away, you can still see them through the glass. I'm trying to get his parents. Sorry, I didn't know who else to ask
